description: This source file implements the core functionality of the 'git notes' command, including handling notes listing, adding, copying, editing, showing, merging, removing, pruning, and retrieving notes references in the Git version control system. It contains function definitions for manipulating and merging notes objects, as well as command-line argument parsing and command dispatch logic.

methods.name: void free_note_data(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a note_data structure, including the editing path, message buffers, and message array.

methods.name: int list_each_note(const struct object_id * object_oid,const struct object_id * note_oid,char * note_path UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Prints a note object ID and its associated object ID; used as a callback for listing notes.

methods.name: void copy_obj_to_fd(int fd,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads an object by ID and writes its raw bytes to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void write_commented_object(int fd,const struct object_id * object)
methods.description: Writes the output of 'git show' with comments added, to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void prepare_note_data(const struct object_id * object,struct note_data * d,const struct object_id * old_note)
methods.description: Prepares note data for editing or writing, including setting up templates, editing files, and invoking editors.

methods.name: void write_note_data(struct note_data * d,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Writes note data to create or update a note object in the object database.

methods.name: void append_separator(struct strbuf * message)
methods.description: Appends a separator string between note messages if applicable.

methods.name: void concat_messages(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Concatenates multiple note messages into a single note buffer, handling spacing and whitespace removal.

methods.name: int parse_msg_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a message argument from command-line options into the note message array.

methods.name: int parse_file_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Reads note message content from a specified file.

methods.name: int parse_reuse_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Reuses the contents of an existing object as a note message.

methods.name: int parse_reedit_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Reuses an existing note object for editing.

methods.name: int parse_separator_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets the separator string for note message paragraphs.

methods.name: int notes_copy_from_stdin(int force,const char * rewrite_cmd)
methods.description: Copies notes based on input read from stdin, supporting rewriting workflows.

methods.name: struct:notes_tree * init_notes_check(const char * subcommand,int flags)
methods.description: Initializes the notes subsystem and verifies that the ref is within refs/notes/ prefix.

methods.name: int list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists notes for objects, optionally filtered by an object ID or all notes.

methods.name: int append_edit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'edit' and 'append' subcommands for 'git notes', handling note content editing.

methods.name: int add(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Adds or replaces a note for a specified object, possibly invoking an editor or message source.

methods.name: int copy(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Copies notes from one object to another, supporting stdin and rewrite workflows.

methods.name: int show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Displays the note associated with a given object.

methods.name: int merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an in-progress notes merge, cleaning up refs and worktrees.

methods.name: int merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge by creating a commit with the merged notes.

methods.name: int git_config_get_notes_strategy(const char * key,enum notes_merge_strategy * strategy)
methods.description: Reads and parses the notes merge strategy from Git config.

methods.name: int merge(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles merging of multiple notes trees with support for conflict resolution strategies.

methods.name: int remove_one_note(struct notes_tree * t,const char * name,unsigned flag)
methods.description: Removes a note for a specific object, given its ref name.

methods.name: int remove_cmd(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'remove' subcommand for 'git notes', deleting notes by object names or stdin.

methods.name: int prune(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Prunes unreferenced or obsolete notes, with verbose and dry-run options.

methods.name: int get_ref(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Outputs the current notes reference name.

methods.name: int cmd_notes(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main dispatcher for 'git notes' subcommands, parsing options and invoking appropriate handlers.
